features.description: Creator Hub composer (iOS + web): pick try-on result, enter caption + tags, choose audience, save draft. Drafts persist locally and sync via the existing draft-sync service.
steps: ComposerViewModel handles try-on selection + caption + tags + audience
DraftRepository persists locally and pushes to backend
Audience picker offers public / followers / collaboration
Validation: caption ≤ 280 chars, tags ≤ 10
features.acceptance: Creator can compose and save a draft. Draft persists across app restarts.

features.description: Creator Hub publish pipeline: backend moderation pass + feed-fanout job + push-notification fan-out. iOS + web invoke the same publish endpoint; the endpoint orchestrates the three downstream steps.
steps: Publish endpoint accepts {draft_id, audience} and triggers moderation synchronously
ModerationService scores caption + tags; returns pass/fail with flag annotation
FeedFanoutJob queues async fan-out on moderation pass
PushNotifService dispatches to follower / public audience
features.acceptance: Publishing a draft triggers moderation within 3s and feed-fanout within 60s for ≥99% of publishes. Push notifications dispatch to the right audience.

features.description: Analytics dashboard: impressions, likes, comments, shares, follower-growth tiles. Default 7-day range; user can switch to 30-day or all-time. Tiles refresh every 5 minutes.
steps: AnalyticsDashboardViewModel fetches tiles for the selected range
RangeSelector switches between 7d / 30d / all-time
5-minute refresh cron updates the tiles in the background
Each tile renders metric value + sparkline
features.acceptance: 7-day range loads within 2s. Range selector switches the underlying data correctly.

features.description: Profile editing: avatar / bio / handle. Avatar upload validates JPG/PNG up to 5MB. Bio supports 160 chars. Handle change preserves the 30-day redirect from the old handle.
steps: ProfileEditViewModel handles avatar / bio / handle edits
AvatarUpload validates type + size
Bio enforces 160-char limit
HandleChange writes a redirect record valid for 30 days
features.acceptance: Profile edits persist. Handle change creates the redirect record.

features.description: Per-feature unit tests + integration tests for composer, publish pipeline, analytics, and profile editing. Each feature gets its own test suite.
steps: ComposerViewModel unit tests
Publish-pipeline integration tests against a backend emulator
AnalyticsDashboard view-state tests
ProfileEdit unit tests
